notes.title: Plasticity will see you at IndieCade
notes.content:
We are honored and excited to share that Plasticity was selected as a nominee for [url=https://www.indiecade.com/]IndieCade Festival 2019[/url]! We will see you in Santa Monica October 10-12. 😊

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35008469/a970030f3e5bf84fef2620f9867acdc6354a2c3c.png[/img]

We are so grateful for all the kindness and support we have received for our humble student project. Thank you for playing Plasticity. Finally, we want to give a huge thank you to [url=https://www.forbes.com/sites/mattpaprocki/2019/07/06/plasticity-merges-narrative-and-climate-politics/]Forbes[/url], [url=https://www.rockpapershotgun.com/2019/05/25/plasticity-is-a-free-game-about-small-acts-of-environmental-kindness/]Rock Paper Shotgun[/url], and everyone who has written about our game.

notes.title: Plasticity will see you at E3
notes.content:
We are incredibly excited to announce Plasticity will be showcasing at the IndieCade booth at E3 in 2019. June 11, 12, 13.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/35008469/fd7330b94d3a48e88e202bd45467c503f4be15cf.png[/img]

A huge thank you to all of our players around the world. We are so grateful for your overwhelming support and help. If you are attending E3, please feel free to stop by our booth to chat and enjoy Plasticity! 💕

Expect an update on optimization and localization soon!

notes.title: Plasticity is a free game about small acts of environmental kindness
notes.content:
Almost the first thing that happens in Plasticity is that the pile of rubbish you re climbing gives way and you fall into a gross, wet cave. Protagonist Noa doesn t look especially thrown off by the event, as though it s happened before. There s even a ladder to get out. It s clearly a world accustomed to living side-by-side with trash. But in setting off to a fabled paradise island, Noa might decide that it doesn t need to be. Take a peek at the trailer below (though the game is free, so you could just try it for yourself).
